question: Does Loss Truncation with a single FIXED warm-up (no data-driven curfew step) work across settings? If one fixed value works everywhere, the value of the data-driven curfew step shrinks (user's borderline condition).

design.toy: variant B seeds with early installs: 1105 (curfew 51, install from 60; Curfew itself fails here), 1103 (install from 70), 1107 (install from 90)
design.real: SQuAD/Qwen s1006 (curfew 9, install 60), SQuAD/Llama s1001 (curfew 9, install 70), phrase/Qwen s1006 (curfew 9, install 100)
design.warmups: fixed 20 and 50 steps; c = best c of the gate-aligned toy sweep (only the start time differs)

criteria: frozen toy / real criteria (see convoy_plan.json); compared with Curfew on the same seeds

predictions.fixed20_toy: uncertain: starts before the curfew step, drops the hardest rows during clean learning (quality risk); on 1105 it may catch the near-curfew poison that defeats Curfew
predictions.fixed50_toy: behaves like the gate-aligned version (toy curfew 49-53): same outcome as LT gate on each seed
predictions.fixed20_real: post-curfew (9) and pre-install (60-100): likely behaves like gate-aligned LT
predictions.fixed50_real: fails on SQuAD/Qwen and Llama if poison consumed in steps 9-50 already started installing; uncertain
predictions.overall: ~40%: some fixed value (most likely 20) holds on >= 2/3 toy and >= 2/3 real -> threat confirmed

rule: threat = one fixed value qualified on >= 2/3 toy seeds AND >= 2/3 real settings -> report to user, no automatic action; otherwise the data-driven curfew step is supported
